correctness.rationale: For N>=3, S>0, equal atomic mass S/N and unit periodic arclength, the centered evaluation Green kernel gives K(x)=1/(12M^2)+S V(x)/M-S^2 W/(2M^2), M=1+S. The identity V″=2nu-2dt makes V an exact curvature -2 quadratic on each atom gap. Exact midpoint and derivative integration yields K=1/12+[S(1+2S)/(12M^2)]sum g_i^3+[S/M]sum g_i(B-V(m_i))+[S^2/(4M^2)]sum g_i[V′(m_i)]^2. The algebraic equality sum g_i^3-N^-2=sum(g_i-N^-1)^2(g_i+2N^-1) proves the claimed deficit and strict uniqueness, and periodic Riesz representation supplies all norming functions. Independent exact variational reconstruction checked 441 rational configurations and 4,410 point evaluations. Finite checks are corroborative, not proof.

value.rationale: Optimizing point masses in the mean-zero functional is an intrinsic operator-norm design problem. The all-N,S sharp constant, positive exact cubic-gap stability, and identification of equality evaluations/functions quantify sensitivity of the entire periodic Sobolev space to sampling geometry. Unlike a bare endpoint computation, the identity explains and measures three independent modes of loss. It is a natural infinite-family classification; no downstream result is required for this exact invariant.
